title: Test Suite Record
description: EXECUTE-stage artifact. Output of unit-test-writer. Records the unit tests written for a given implementation, listing the test targets and the generated test file paths. At least one test target (loader/prompt/metric/loss) is required — an empty suite is not a valid deliverable.

from_implementation_ref.description: Optional reference to the implementation_record this test suite covers.

test_targets.description: The logical targets covered by this test suite (e.g. loader, prompt, metric, loss). At least one required.

test_files.description: Paths to the test files written (relative to project root).

path.description: Relative path to the test file.

n_tests.description: Number of test functions in this file.

coverage_pct.description: Measured code coverage percentage, if available. Null until externally run.

notes.description: Any known gaps, edge cases deferred, or follow-up tests planned.
